mainEntity.name: What are the main benefits of indoor cycling classes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indoor cycling classes offer a highly effective cardiovascular workout, building endurance and strengthening major muscle groups like your quads, hamstrings, glutes, and core. Because it's a low-impact exercise, it's gentle on joints while still burning significant calories. At Cave Training, our classes provide a structured environment with motivating instructors and music, helping you push your limits and achieve fitness goals in a dynamic group setting. It's an excellent way to maintain fitness regardless of weather conditions or outdoor safety concerns.
acceptedAnswer.description: Indoor cycling provides a low-impact, high-intensity cardiovascular workout that builds endurance and strengthens muscles in a motivating group setting.
